Use only the facts given. Write each section as one or two short paragraphs.

## Hypothesis

Claude Sonnet 5 answers support questions as helpfully as Claude Fable 5.1, with no more latency and at lower cost.

## Setup

The experiment compared the current model (us.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1) against the cheaper model (us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5) using a 50/50 split across 150 identities and 1500 answers.

## Timeline

The plan was approved and the experiment started at 15:30. A latency alarm triggered at 15:42, causing the cheaper model to be rolled back. A health probe passed at 15:51 and the resume was approved. Results were ready at 16:20.

## Results

Each arm had 75 identities. The current model achieved a helpful rate of 0.81, mean latency of 5072 ms, and mean cost of 9100 micro-USD. The cheaper model achieved a helpful rate of 0.80, mean latency of 2782 ms, and mean cost of 2300 micro-USD. The confidence interval lower bound for the helpful rate lift was -0.04, indicating the cheaper model's helpfulness cannot yet be confirmed as non-inferior.

## Guardrails

Both the latency and cost guardrails passed.

## Incident

One rollback occurred due to an injected 10-second delay on the cheaper model, lasting 6 minutes.

## Known bias

Identities that were rolled back during the incident are still counted in the cheaper arm, which may distort the cheaper model's measured performance.

## Recommendation

Hold and re-run the experiment to obtain a cleaner comparison unaffected by the incident.

## Time taken

50 minutes elapsed from the initial prompt to results being ready.
